issue: where() compared a POSIX relative name to str(SCHEMA), which uses the platform separator, so on Windows a db/schema.rb table would be named as coming from a second file. Fix: SCHEMA.as_posix() in where() and in the stale-table mutation. Fixed at 7fd8a41b.

A file named cache_schema.rb, queue_schema.rb or cable_schema.rb was skipped by its name alone, so a project's own table in a file of that name was never checked. Fix: skip it only when every table in it starts with solid_, with selftest cases for a non-Solid cache_schema.rb and for a trio file holding one non-solid table. Fixed at 7fd8a41b.

build_project_wiki.parse_schema and the wiki and graph builders read only db/schema.rb, so a second database's tables are missing from docs/wiki/Data-Model.md. Not changed in this PR; filed as claude-skills #1698.
